en.hero_tagline: The platform that is most helpful to farmers and turning crop waste into useful products.
en.intro_para_1: Our platform empowers farmers to increase income by directly connecting them with buyers. We bridge the gap between agricultural producers and markets, ensuring fair prices and transparent transactions.
en.intro_para_2: We also promote sustainable practices by turning crop waste into valuable products like eco‑friendly plates, fabrics, and bags, creating a circular economy for rural communities.
en.section_hiw_title: Start Earning More in 4 Simple Steps
en.section_hiw_desc: Whether you want to sell produce directly or monetize crop waste, our platform makes it simple and transparent.
en.step_1_desc: Sign up and list your harvest produce or available crop waste. It takes less than 2 minutes.
en.step_2_desc: Our system connects you with verified buyers and recycling companies in Andhra Pradesh and South India.
en.step_3_desc: Talk directly with buyers — no middlemen, no hidden fees, no commission cuts from your hard-earned income.
en.step_4_desc: Receive fair payment for your produce and generate secondary income by selling crop waste to eco-product manufacturers.
en.section_waste_title: Turning Agricultural Waste into Useful Eco-Products
en.section_waste_desc: Discover how paddy husk, rice straw, corn stalks, and sugarcane bagasse are transformed into biodegradable everyday items.
en.section_testimonials_desc: Real stories from real farmers who have increased their income through Gen Z TS.
en.testimonial_1_quote: "Before Gen Z TS, I had to sell my paddy to middlemen at low prices. Now I sell directly to buyers in Hyderabad and earn ₹400 more per quintal. This platform changed my life."
en.testimonial_2_quote: "I used to burn my rice husk every season. Now I sell it to Agriware India and earn ₹15,000 extra per acre. My crop waste is now a source of income!"
en.testimonial_3_quote: "The language support in Telugu makes it so easy. I registered my corn waste in 2 minutes and got a call from a recycling company the same week. Very useful platform."
en.section_directory_title: 10 Verified Andhra Pradesh Companies Converting Agricultural Waste
en.section_directory_desc: Direct contact information, location, accepted waste materials, and eco-friendly products produced.
en.search_recyclers_ph: Search company name, district, or product...
en.section_market_desc: Connect directly with trusted farmers in Andhra Pradesh and South India to buy fresh harvest produce without middleman commissions.
en.section_form_title: List Your Crop Waste for Secondary Income
en.section_form_desc: Are you a farmer with leftover paddy straw, rice husk, or corn stalks? Submit your waste details and get direct purchase offers from bioplastic and tableware manufacturers.
en.section_faq_desc: Everything you need to know about using Gen Z TS to sell produce and crop waste.
en.faq_q1: Is there any fee to register on Gen Z TS?
en.faq_a1: No, Gen Z TS is completely free for farmers. There are zero registration fees and zero commission charges. Our mission is to empower farmers, not profit from them.
en.faq_q2: How do I sell my crop waste through this platform?
en.faq_a2: Simply scroll to the "Sell Your Waste" section, fill in your details including waste type and quantity, and submit. Verified recycling companies will contact you directly with purchase offers.
en.faq_q3: Which types of crop waste can I sell?
en.faq_a3: You can sell paddy husk & straw, corn stalks & starch, sugarcane bagasse, areca palm sheaths, and other agricultural residue. These are converted into eco-friendly plates, bags, bottles, and textiles.
en.faq_q4: Is the platform available in my language?
en.faq_a4: Yes! Gen Z TS supports 6 languages: English, Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, Malayalam, and Kannada. Use the language selector in the top menu to switch.
en.faq_q5: How much extra income can I earn from crop waste?
en.faq_a5: Farmers typically earn ₹10,000–₹15,000+ additional revenue per acre per season by selling crop waste that would otherwise be burned.
